main_body: Sci-fi building: panelled blue-grey sloped roof above a grey metal front wall with windows and a central double door
top_band: Light blue-grey roof slope with panel seams, rows ~1-15 at the middle column, ending in a pale front-edge lip at rows 16-18
evidence: The roof is a tall, clearly visible top surface with skylight vents and seams. It ends in a light edge (rows 16-18) and an orange trim band (rows 19-20) that shades the wall below. The wall (rows 21-42) is a separate vertical face with inset dark-framed windows and a recessed door. The roof and wall are both clearly drawn, so this reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The roof has about 4 blue-grey steps, and the dark navy outline leans blue, so it reads as material-tone. The roof panels and wall sections are large flat areas of one colour, with only a few speckle dots and seam lines. The Beodeul references carry per-tile highlights, scalloped tiles, plaster speckle and individually shaded stones, so each tile holds many more colours. The candidate would look flatter and thinner beside them.
